newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Winterthur says H1 '95 net around 200 mln Sfr.
newsitem.headline: Winterthur says H1 '95 net around 200 mln Sfr.

text.p: Winterthur Insurance Co. said group net profit in the first half of 1995 was approximately 200 million Swiss francs on a comparable basis to the 248.4 million francs reported for the first half of 1996.

Winterthur chairman and chief executive Peter Spaelti told a news conference the company on purpose had not published a six month comparitive figure for 1995 because of the cost involved and because the accuracy of such a figure would be questionable.
Earlier today Winterthur for the first time reported full interim results for the first half of 1996.
Asked whether a comparison to 1995 was availble, Spaelti said the company had estimated a figure.
"We assume the half-year result in 1995 would have been around 200 million francs," Spaelti said, cautioning the figure was not accurate.
"But without any doubt, the first half 1996 result was a good result," he added.
